ConfirmRemoveReference.zhs: 移除当前文件夹中的这条引用？
ConfirmRemoveReference.en: Remove this reference from the current folder?

PublicUnavailable.zhs: 公共空间尚未初始化，请联系管理员。
PublicUnavailable.en: Public space is not initialized. Contact an administrator.

PersonalUnavailable.zhs: 个人空间尚未初始化或不可读取，请重试或联系管理员。
PersonalUnavailable.en: Personal space is not initialized or cannot be read. Retry or contact an administrator.

SearchDisabled.zhs: 工作空间未启用树搜索。

SubjectInputForbidden.zhs: 个人空间命令不接受客户端主体。
SubjectInputForbidden.en: The personal space command does not accept a client-provided subject.

DescriptionTooLong.zhs: 说明必须是文本，且不能超过 500 个字符。
DescriptionTooLong.en: Description must be text and cannot exceed 500 characters.

InvalidName.zhs: 文件夹名称不能为空，且不能超过 256 个字符。
InvalidName.en: Folder name is required and cannot exceed 256 characters.

SiblingNameConflict.zhs: 当前文件夹中已有同名子文件夹，请使用其他名称。
SiblingNameConflict.en: A child folder with this name already exists. Choose another name.

DuplicateReference.zhs: 当前文件夹中已存在该对象的引用。
DuplicateReference.en: This object is already referenced by the current folder.

CycleForbidden.zhs: 该引用会形成文件夹循环，请选择其他文件夹。
CycleForbidden.en: This reference would create a folder cycle. Choose another folder.

RootReferenceForbidden.zhs: 空间根文件夹不能添加为引用。
RootReferenceForbidden.en: A space root folder cannot be added as a reference.

ParentWriteDenied.zhs: 没有编辑当前文件夹内容的权限。
ParentWriteDenied.en: You do not have permission to edit the contents of this folder.

FolderCreateDenied.zhs: 没有创建文件夹的权限。
FolderCreateDenied.en: You do not have permission to create a folder.

CandidateReadDenied.zhs: 没有读取此对象类型的权限，请选择其他类型或联系管理员。
CandidateReadDenied.en: You do not have permission to read this object type. Choose another type or contact an administrator.

TargetUnavailable.zhs: 所选对象不可用或不可读取，请重新选择。
TargetUnavailable.en: The selected object is unavailable or cannot be read. Select another object.

ReferenceUnavailable.zhs: 该引用不可用或不可读取，请刷新后重试。
ReferenceUnavailable.en: This reference is unavailable or cannot be read. Refresh and try again.

PositionUnavailable.zhs: 当前位置已失效或无法访问，请刷新后重试。
PositionUnavailable.en: This location is no longer valid or cannot be accessed. Refresh and try again.

InvalidEndpoint.zhs: 所选对象类型或标识无效，请重新选择。
InvalidEndpoint.en: The selected object type or identifier is invalid. Select another object.

ServerFieldForbidden.zhs: 请求包含由服务端维护的字段，请刷新后重试。
ServerFieldForbidden.en: The request contains fields maintained by the server. Refresh and try again.

InvalidPosition.zhs: 工作空间位置请求无效，请刷新后重试。
InvalidPosition.en: The workspace location request is invalid. Refresh and try again.

InvalidCandidateQuery.zhs: 候选查询参数无效，请重新打开选择窗口。
InvalidCandidateQuery.en: The candidate query parameters are invalid. Reopen the selection dialog.

InvalidCreateInput.zhs: 新建文件夹的请求无效，请刷新后重试。
InvalidCreateInput.en: The create-folder request is invalid. Refresh and try again.

InvalidDetailQuery.zhs: 属性查询参数无效，请重新打开属性。
InvalidDetailQuery.en: The property query parameters are invalid. Reopen the properties.

InvalidReferenceInput.zhs: 引用操作的请求无效，请刷新后重试。
InvalidReferenceInput.en: The reference request is invalid. Refresh and try again.

InvalidPage.zhs: 请求的页码无效，请重新查询。
InvalidPage.en: The requested page is invalid. Run the query again.

SubjectRequired.zhs: 请登录后再执行工作空间操作。
SubjectRequired.en: Sign in before using workspace operations.

UnsupportedQueryDirection.zhs: 此工作空间查询方向不受支持。
UnsupportedQueryDirection.en: This workspace query direction is not supported.
